title: Planning permission in force; commencement deadline not passed
why: If development did not begin before the deadline the permission has expired and a new application is needed.
how: Decision date plus the Condition 1 time limit gives a commencement deadline of 12 Jun 2027, compared with the run date.

evidence.heading: Condition 1: Time limit
evidence.paragraph_text: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
